en: Stop all activity and sit or lie down.
Call the crew medical officer now.
Follow the onboard chest pain procedure, step 1.
Stop all activity and stay upright.
Call the crew medical officer now.
Check cabin air readings and follow the breathing procedure, step 1.
ko: 선내 공기 수치를 확인하고 호흡 절차서 1단계를 따라요.

en: You are not alone. A crewmate is being called now.
Stay where you are with the crewmate.
The medical officer and the ground team are notified.
ko: 혼자가 아니에요. 지금 동료 승무원을 부르고 있어요.
동료와 함께 지금 있는 곳에 있어요.

en: Call the crew medical officer now.
Follow the onboard emergency procedure, step 1.
